title: 松尾芭蕉の俳句 (Haiku by Matsuo Bashō)
description: Six famous haiku by Matsuo Bashō (1644–1694), the master who elevated haiku into a high literary art. From the ancient frog's splash that shattered and then deepened eternal silence, to his final poem dictated from his deathbed — still dreaming of wandering across withered autumn fields.
author: 松尾芭蕉 (Matsuo Bashō, 1644–1694)
license: Public Domain (青空文庫 — Matsuo Bashō died 1694)
